full_judgment: 7. All these papers filed by the petitioner coupled with the facts that the original lease deed of Jamshed Khas has come before this Court from the custody of the petitioner and that there is nothing before us from the side of the respondent to show that Government or anybody else ever took possession of the property in question as abandoned property, sufficiently support the petitioner's case that Jamshed Khan was all along present in Bangladesh and he never abandoned the property in question. So, it appears to us that the property in question did not answer to the definition of "abandoned property" as defined in Article 2(1) of the President's Order No. 16 of 1972.
